metrics.unit: window; correlated within original record, not independent specimen
metrics.macro_f1: mean of four 2TP/(2TP+FP+FN); zero denominator gives 0
metrics.balanced_accuracy: mean recall of true-supported classes; all four supported here
metrics.confusion_matrix: rows true, columns predicted, fixed class_order
metrics.per_record: window count, correct count, predicted counts, true-class recall/accuracy, four-class matrix

output_rules.decision_score: four uncalibrated OVR scores in class_order; not probabilities
output_rules.prediction: SVC.predict OVO voting; do not substitute OVR argmax
output_rules.errors: retain all misclassifications and all execution failures; never omit failed rows
output_rules.resume: explicit --resume only; validate persisted batches; record every interruption and recovery
output_rules.repeat: one complete formal evaluation; subsequent metric checks read persisted results only
